subject: SOC2 re-attestation & retention plan for renewal - Acme Payments
messages:
From: Tom Harris <t.harris@acmepayments.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Nina Gomez <security@acmepayments.com>, Legal - Acme <legal@acmepayments.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: SOC2 re-attestation required for renewal - scope questions

Hi Mateo,

As we approach our contract renewal in November, our compliance team has asked for an updated SOC 2 re-attestation that reflects two changes on our side: a longer log retention requirement (from 12 months to 24 months) and inclusion of a small subset of on-prem audit logs for dispute forensic purposes.

Can Redwood confirm whether the current evidence bundle and log export process can support 24 months of retention and provide a plan for handoff of sample logs? Also, we may need a short amendment to the terms around retention and a pricing delta for the extra storage and retrieval windows.

We want to avoid blocking the renewal. Can you outline what you need and an estimated timeline for deliverables (evidence package, log export script, and any contract language)?

Thanks,
Tom Harris
Head of Security Operations
Acme Payments

Attachments: none
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>
To: Tom Harris <t.harris@acmepayments.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 15 Sep 2026 10:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SOC2 re-attestation required for renewal - scope questions

Tom — thanks for the heads up and for being specific about retention and on-prem logs. We can support a 24 month retention window; there are two pieces to coordinate: (1) evidence & attestation updates for the SOC 2 artifact set and (2) a logistics plan for delivering and sampling the on-prem logs you described.

High level proposal from Redwood:
- Evidence bundle: we'll assemble an updated evidence index and supporting artifacts (controls mappings, change log, access logs) by Sept 28.
- Log retention: extend retention in our log tier to 24 months and provide documented export steps; we estimate configuration + validation by Oct 12.
- On-prem sample exports: we can accept encrypted sample uploads or pull samples via a mutually agreed secure SFTP. We will provide a validation checklist and sample extraction script.
- Contract amendment: legal/ops will propose a short addendum for the retention change + storage delta; we can scope pricing impact roughly at +6-8% on the annual contract value, pending exact size.

I'll loop in Kimberly and Karthik to own evidence collection and pricing. If that timeline works, I'll schedule a short runbook review with your security team this week.

Best,
Mateo
Senior Customer Success Manager
Redwood Inference

Subject: Internal: Acme re-attestation + retention change (need support)

Team — quick alignment note on Acme (ACME-2026-RNW1). Customer is requesting SOC 2 re-attestation modified to cover 24 month log retention and occasional on-prem log samples for forensic review. Renewal target: November.

What I need:
- Kimberly: lead evidence build (index, control mappings, updated access logs). Target: Sept 28 for first pass. Can you confirm resource availability?
- Karthik: help size the storage delta and propose pricing change (estimate +6-8% ballpark). Also confirm whether our retention SLA change requires engineering lead time beyond the configs Karthik outlined previously. Target: Oct 5 for pricing and seat impact.
- Laura: flag this with Legal for a short retention addendum; let us know if we should route via procurement or if a simple amendment will do.

Customer is open to a 30-45 minute runbook review this week; Mateo to coordinate. I will compile a draft evidence index once Kimberly confirms.

Thanks — Mateo

Attachments: none
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwoodinference.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 16 Sep 2026 09:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Internal: Acme re-attestation + retention change (need support)

Folks — I can take point on the evidence bundle. Summary of what I'll deliver by Sept 28 (first pass):
- SOC2_evidence_index.csv (controls -> artifact mapping) [attached stub]
- Updated access and change logs export (last 24 months) — staging snapshot and verification report
- Validation checklist for on-prem sample ingestion and redaction guidance

Notes / constraints:
- Exporting full 24 months of raw token-level logs will increase storage and transfer time; we'll provide a pruned export (redacted PII) by default and a process for tightly scoped raw exports under NDA when needed.
- Engineering needs a one-week window for large export validation. If Acme wants full raw pulls, Karthik, please confirm the bandwidth window (best to schedule during low-traffic hours).

Attaching: SOC2_evidence_index.csv (stub), MA-Prefix_logs_sample.txt (small sample)

Kimberly Park
Manager, Security Compliance
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SOC2_evidence_index.csv (csv), MA-Prefix_logs_sample.txt (text)
